faqs.q: How fast can a plumber get to my Vancouver home?
faqs.a: For emergency calls, our typical response time is 60 to 90 minutes to most Vancouver neighborhoods. For non-emergency appointments, we offer same-day and next-day scheduling with a two-hour arrival window.

faqs.q: How much does emergency plumbing cost?
faqs.a: Costs vary by the nature of the repair, but we never charge overtime rates for nights, weekends, or holidays. We charge a dispatch fee for emergency calls and give you a written estimate before work begins - you approve the price before we start. Call us and we can often provide a general cost range over the phone.

faqs.q: What should I do if a pipe bursts?
faqs.a: Shut off your main water supply immediately - the valve is usually near the water meter or where the water line enters the house. Then call (360) 369-3586 for emergency service. While waiting, clean up standing water and move furniture and valuables away from the affected area.
